ambiguity_challenges.resolution: The public request selects the strongest name. Explicit conjunction aliases normalize to it because Definition 11 includes the basic condition.

ambiguity_challenges.resolution: Both public prompts explicitly reject the added simple-normal-crossing restriction.

interpretations: Use the definition stated in the version being reported

ambiguity_challenges.difference: The uniform interpretation attributes an explicit reduced qualifier to v1's definition even though that word is absent there. This lexical difference does not establish whether the corresponding geometric classes differ.
ambiguity_challenges.resolution: Both public prompts now require each version's own definition and wording. Their existing author-statements-only rule excludes repairing definitions by inference. No private rule supplies an extra public eligibility condition.

Each prompt still states the research goal and delivery in its opening. The replacement separates version-specific definition authority from exclusions. It supplies no row values or new entry hints.
